Class OfferController

      Post Controller for creating the offer. Uses Request params listed below. Available at endpoint /api/offer/new-offer

      photo - - The photo file.

      body - - Body of the offer (600 chars max)
      Returns:
      Response Entity with status either OK or INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR

      @PostMapping("/edit-offer") @RolesAllowed("ROLE_USER") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<String> editOffer(@RequestParam("id") Long id, @RequestParam(value="photo",required=false) org.springframework.web.multipart.MultipartFile photo, @RequestParam(value="title",required=false) String title, @RequestParam(value="location",required=false) String location, @RequestParam(value="region",required=false) String region, @RequestParam(value="body",required=false) String body)
      Post Controller for editing an existing offer. Available at endpoint /api/offer/edit-offer
      Parameters:
      id - - The ID of the offer to be edited
      photo - - The updated photo file (optional, can be null if not being updated).
      title - - Updated title of the offer (80 chars max)
      body - - Updated body of the offer (600 chars max)
      Returns:
      ResponseEntity with status either OK or NOT_FOUND or INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR
